title: Effects of Lactobacillus reuteri DSM 17938 on the acute psychological, endocrine and immunological stress response in healthy urbans
summary: The aim of this human study is to investigate whether prior, repeated, oral administration of L. reuteri DSM 17938 is capable of influencing the acute psychological, endocrine, cardiovascular, and immunological stress response in young, healthy city dwellers.

interventions.name:

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
BMI between 19 and 30; grew up in a large city (>40,000 inhabitants) without a pet (dog, cat) until the age of 15
Exclusion criteria:
current infections; chronic affective or somatic disorders; smoking; competitive athletes; acute exercise within 24h before blood draws; drug taking (NSAID, cannabis, etc.); acutely (within the last 6 months) bereaved or divorced
